title: Casino Advertising vs. Editorial Rankings: Know the Difference
summary: Understand how paid placements, affiliate links, sponsorship labels and independent review criteria should be separated.
body:
## Advertising and reviews serve different purposes

A review is meant to help readers evaluate a product using stated criteria. An advertisement is paid promotion. Both can appear on the same page, but the distinction should remain visible so a reader can tell what is editorial judgment and what is a sponsored message.

## Look for a clear label

Paid banners, background takeovers and sponsored placements should be identified as advertising. The label should not be buried where a reasonable visitor is unlikely to see it. A promotional background on a review page does not make the review itself a purchased endorsement.

## Understand affiliate links

Some sites may earn a commission when visitors follow a link or complete a qualifying action. That financial relationship should be disclosed. It is useful to ask whether commissions influence which operators are included, the prominence of their links, or the order of reviews.

## Read the scoring method

A trustworthy ranking explains its factors, the type of evidence used and how uncertainty is handled. If a site says a casino is first because of fast payouts, the speed claim should have a defined measurement method and supporting records. Popularity and advertising budget are not payout evidence.

## Consider what the reviewer could not verify

Missing data should not silently become a perfect score. A site may discuss publicly available terms even when it has not conducted an independent deposit or withdrawal test. Readers deserve to know the difference.

## RawEdge's stated policy

RawEdge offers advertising placements, including the possibility of clearly labeled promotional content on individual casino profiles. Advertising does not buy a favorable editorial rating or top ranking. Its test claims must be supported by actual documentation, and operators cannot purchase a passing result.

## Use judgment across the industry

Disclosure and methodology help you compare information sources; neither guarantees that every statement is correct. Check current terms and relevant regulator information independently. Casino gambling involves risk and is not a guaranteed income source.
source_notes: Based on RawEdge about.html, advertise.html and how-we-rate.html editorial policy. Describes RawEdge commitment, not other companies' actual practices.
